title: Sam Altman - How to Succeed with a Startup
summary: A 16-minute Y Combinator Startup School talk in which Sam Altman lays out what makes a startup succeed. It covers building a product people tell friends about, exponential markets, real versus fake trends, and having an ambitious vision.
why: Recommended as the single Startup School video worth watching, a short and dense talk on what makes a startup work; one commenter dismisses it as platitudes.

quote.text: If you watch one SUS video ever then watch this 16 minute video from Sam Altman
